edits.new:
And a document whose stored type has left the version in force is returned under its stored type, and a read that cannot complete answers 503 with MSG-GEN-006 and no partial answer

  Scenario: AC11 An error answer of the provided operations is 401 or 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-access contract mock returns no identity for the call
    When a caller without an identity calls GET /api/recovery/document/v1/cases/RW-2026-000901/document-checklist
    Then the call answers 401 and holds no item, no document ID and no count
    And a call for a case ID that does not exist answers 404 and holds no item and no document ID

  Scenario: AC12 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the reference-data contract mock returns the checklist version in force for case type "MORTGAGE_CIVIL" with 9 items
    When "SY-AGENT" requests a status change of a checklist item of case "RW-2026-000901" that the model does not allow
    Then the call is refused with the refusal status Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P5-E2030-APP-AC12) and no row of any table of rwb_document is inserted, updated or deleted
    And the item keeps the status it held before the call
